author: Sevoo
body:
Hi wuddup 

First off, the leaderboards aren't updating I've been at 86 mons this week for over a week now. I don't know when they update but make it sooner because, well, it's better.

Second, after 1 month of play time it won't update until you've played for 2 months. Please fix it because, well, it's better.

Not big suggestions I just found them a bit annoying and because Atlas is coming and devs are actually listening to suggestions (tbh gj devs) I'd thought I make this.
